REVIEW_STRATIFIED_SAMPLE.meaning: Each selected phrase is an intentionally diverse direct Search sample from a Step-07 uncertainty stratum. It is NOT a marker-authority for the other rows sharing corrected_reason or acquisition source.

NONEXACT_DUPLICATE_VARIANT.meaning: Both variants of every active duplicate candidate are directly queried before any later merge decision.

STEP1_BOUNDARY_OR_CORE_ANCHOR.meaning: These are explicit control/contrast queries for known architecture questions; they do not represent all phrases in an acquisition family.

manual_semantic_review_notes: The previous manifest incorrectly treated corrected_reason as a surrogate SERP family and acquisition source as a surrogate subfamily. That interpretation is rejected.

The same 75 direct queries may still be useful as a bounded first tranche because they provide broad diagnostic coverage, all active duplicate pairs, and declared Step-01/core contrasts. Their evidence may resolve the exact queried phrase and declared direct comparison only until a separate evidence-transfer decision is made.
Lexical centrality and Wordstat provenance may be used to diversify or order sampling, but never to prove shared intent, same-page compatibility, or transferability to non-probed rows.

After each SERP is collected, any proposal to transfer evidence to a non-probed phrase must be explicit, justified by semantic compatibility and/or additional SERP evidence, and remain reversible until Step 10 clustering.
This QA approves the tranche for evidence acquisition only. It does not approve Step 09 completion, clustering, page ownership, or resolution of all 944 REVIEW_SEARCH rows.
